programs.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
programs.sub_title: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle
programs.desc: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.

programs.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
programs.sub_title: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher
programs.desc: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

programs.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programs.sub_title: A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs
programs.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programs.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programs.sub_title: Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch
programs.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

programs.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition"
programs.sub_title: An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition
programs.desc: Brainpower and firepower transform 8,000 kilograms of computer-controlled machinery into a legendary dogfighter with the best fight and flight record in the sky; the Lockheed Martin F16.

programs.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV"
programs.sub_title: Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV
programs.desc: Developed from solidified vegetable oil, this military grade compound is a long way from department store concealer: it’s sweat proof, infrared resistant, and stays on in the drenching downpour. For soldiers, especially Special Ops and snipers, camo paint completes their covert coverage.
